entries.name: ponytail
entries.description: Makes your AI agent think like the laziest senior dev in the room. The best code is the code you never wrote.

why.zh: 近 7 天新增 7,454 star（日均约 1,065，相对存量增速 4.8%），累计 154,160 star、8,292 fork。窗口内被 fork 411 次，近 30 天新建 PR 162 个、issue 200 个，82 位贡献者共同维护。
why.en: Gained 7,454 stars over the last 7 days (~1,065/day, 4.8% of its base), now at 154,160 stars and 8,292 forks. 411 new forks in the window; 162 PRs and 200 issues opened in the last 30 days; 82 contributors.

intro.zh: Ponytail 是一个提示词技能，让你的编码智能体像「房间里最懒的资深工程师」那样思考：能不写就不写，写就写最少的那几行。装好后每个会话自动生效，动手前会沿着「能删就删、能复用就复用」的阶梯停在第一层够用的方案上，也能用 /ponytail-review 检查当前 diff 是不是过度设计。
intro.en: Ponytail is a prompt skill that makes your coding agent think like the laziest senior dev in the room: write the one line that works instead of the fifty that don't. It stays active every session, walking a ladder of simpler options before writing anything, and /ponytail-review hands back a delete-list for the current diff.

cardLine.zh: 让编码智能体少写代码的技能：先找最省事的方案，再动手实现。
cardLine.en: A skill that makes coding agents write less code by stopping at the simplest solution that holds.

highlights.zh: 写码前先走「懒惰阶梯」，能一行解决就不写五十行
highlights.en: Walks a laziness ladder before writing code, so a one-line fix beats a fifty-line one

highlights.zh: 支持 lite / full / ultra 等强度切换，也可以随时关掉
highlights.en: Switch intensity with lite / full / ultra, or turn it off entirely

highlights.zh: /ponytail-review 审当前 diff，直接给出可以删掉的清单
highlights.en: /ponytail-review scans the current diff for over-engineering and returns a delete-list

highlights.zh: 省事但不省责任：校验、数据丢失处理、安全与可访问性不动
highlights.en: Lazy, not negligent: validation, data-loss handling, security and accessibility stay

highlights.zh: Claude Code 装成两个提示，Codex 走 hooks，其他 agent 复制 AGENTS.md
highlights.en: Installs as two prompts in Claude Code, via hooks in Codex, or by copying AGENTS.md elsewhere

cons.zh: 未声明开源许可证，商用存在法务不确定性
cons.en: No open-source license declared — legal uncertainty for commercial use

entries.name: orca
entries.description: Orca is the ADE for working with a fleet of parallel agents. Run any coding agent with your own subscription. Available on desktop, mobile and remote runtime.

why.zh: 近 7 天新增 5,467 star（日均约 781，相对存量增速 6.5%），累计 84,662 star、5,463 fork。窗口内被 fork 279 次，近 30 天新建 PR 200 个、issue 200 个，100 位贡献者共同维护。
why.en: Gained 5,467 stars over the last 7 days (~781/day, 6.5% of its base), now at 84,662 stars and 5,463 forks. 279 new forks in the window; 200 PRs and 200 issues opened in the last 30 days; 100 contributors.

intro.zh: Orca 是一个围绕「多智能体并行开发」的 ADE（智能体开发环境）。你可以把同一个需求同时派给 Codex、Claude Code 等编码智能体，每个跑在独立的 git worktree 里，最后对比结果、合并胜出的那个。桌面端、手机端和远程运行时都能用，在手机上也能看进度、发后续指令。
intro.en: Orca is an ADE (agent development environment) built for running a fleet of coding agents in parallel. Fan one prompt across Codex, Claude Code and others — each in its own isolated git worktree — then compare results and merge the winner. It runs on desktop, mobile and remote runtimes, so you can monitor and steer agents from your phone.

cardLine.zh: 并行调度多个编码智能体的开发环境，支持 worktree 隔离与手机远程操控。
cardLine.en: An ADE for running a fleet of parallel coding agents, with worktree isolation and mobile control.

highlights.zh: 一条提示分发给多个智能体，各自独立 worktree 运行，对比后合并胜出方案
highlights.en: Fan one prompt across several agents, each in its own worktree, then merge the best result

highlights.zh: 手机 App 监控进度，智能体完成时收到通知，随时补发后续指令
highlights.en: Mobile companion app notifies you when an agent finishes and lets you send follow-ups

highlights.zh: SSH 远程 worktree：把智能体跑在更强的远程机器上，自动重连和端口转发都内置
highlights.en: SSH worktrees run agents on a beefy remote box, with auto-reconnect and port forwarding

highlights.zh: 原生浏览 GitHub 与 Linear，从任务直接开 worktree，还能在 AI diff 上批注回传给智能体
highlights.en: Browse GitHub and Linear in-app, open a worktree from any task, and annotate AI diffs back to the agent

cons.zh: 开放 issue 7,496 个，相对 star 规模偏高
cons.en: 7,496 open issues — high relative to its star count

entries.name: Agent-Reach
entries.description: Give your AI agent eyes to see the entire internet. Read & search Twitter, Reddit, YouTube, GitHub, Bilibili, XiaoHongShu — one CLI, zero API fees.

why.zh: 近 7 天新增 4,596 star（日均约 657，相对存量增速 5.1%），累计 90,274 star、7,938 fork。窗口内被 fork 406 次，近 30 天新建 PR 73 个、issue 96 个，36 位贡献者共同维护。
why.en: Gained 4,596 stars over the last 7 days (~657/day, 5.1% of its base), now at 90,274 stars and 7,938 forks. 406 new forks in the window; 73 PRs and 96 issues opened in the last 30 days; 36 contributors.

intro.zh: Agent Reach 是一个命令行工具，给你的编码智能体补上「上网」的能力：装好即可读任意网页、YouTube 字幕和 RSS，再配置一下就能搜 Twitter、Reddit、小红书、B 站、Instagram、LinkedIn 等平台。它把接入方式替你选好装好，并用 agent-reach doctor 一条命令告诉你哪些通道通了、哪些没通。
intro.en: Agent Reach is a CLI that gives your coding agent eyes on the internet: read any web page, YouTube subtitles and RSS out of the box, then configure it to search Twitter/X, Reddit, Xiaohongshu, Bilibili, Instagram, LinkedIn and more — no paid APIs. It picks and installs the working method for you, and agent-reach doctor tells you what's connected and how to fix what isn't.

cardLine.zh: 给智能体装上读全网能力的 CLI：推文、Reddit、YouTube、B站等。
cardLine.en: A CLI that gives agents the ability to read the web: X, Reddit, YouTube, Bilibili and more.

highlights.zh: 开箱即用读任意网页、YouTube 字幕和 RSS，不用额外配置
highlights.en: Read any web page, YouTube subtitles and RSS with zero configuration

highlights.zh: 配置后解锁 Twitter、Reddit、小红书、B站、Instagram、LinkedIn 的搜索与阅读
highlights.en: After setup, unlock search and reading on Twitter, Reddit, Xiaohongshu, Bilibili, Instagram and LinkedIn

highlights.zh: 每个平台都有首选加备选后端，某个接入方式失效时自动换下一个
highlights.en: Each platform has primary and backup backends, so a broken method is swapped without you noticing

highlights.zh: agent-reach doctor 一条命令体检各平台连通与修复方式
highlights.en: agent-reach doctor diagnoses which platforms work and how to fix the ones that don't

highlights.zh: Cookie 只存本地不上传，兼容任何能跑命令行的智能体
highlights.en: Cookies stay local and are never uploaded; works with any agent that can run a CLI command

entries.name: ECC
entries.description: The agent harness performance optimization system. Skills, instincts, memory, security, and research-first development for Claude Code, Codex, Opencode, Cursor and beyond.

why.zh: 近 7 天新增 4,467 star（日均约 638，相对存量增速 1.6%），累计 272,558 star、40,691 fork。窗口内被 fork 640 次，近 30 天新建 PR 200 个、issue 200 个，100 位贡献者共同维护。
why.en: Gained 4,467 stars over the last 7 days (~638/day, 1.6% of its base), now at 272,558 stars and 40,691 forks. 640 new forks in the window; 200 PRs and 200 issues opened in the last 30 days; 100 contributors.

intro.zh: ECC 是给编码智能体加装的「工程系统」：让它先规划再动手、用测试验证改动、换个干净的上下文自查代码、把重要的事记下来，并把反复有效的做法沉淀成可复用的技能和工作流。装一次就能用在 Claude Code、Codex 以及 Cursor、OpenCode、Gemini 等多个 harness 上。
intro.en: ECC is an engineering system you install into your coding agent: it plans before it builds, verifies changes with tests, reviews its own work from a fresh context, remembers what matters, and turns repeated wins into reusable skills and workflows. Install it once instead of rebuilding that process in every prompt, across Claude Code, Codex and other harnesses.

cardLine.zh: 给编码智能体加装规划、验证、记忆与技能沉淀的工程化系统。
cardLine.en: An engineering system that gives coding agents planning, verification, memory and reusable skills.

highlights.zh: 内置 68 个 agent、293 个 skill，以及 hooks、rules、记忆等配置
highlights.en: Ships 68 agents, 293 skills, plus hooks, rules and memory configuration

highlights.zh: 研究优先：先计划再写码，改动用测试验证，再换新上下文自审
highlights.en: Research-first flow: plan before building, verify changes with tests, then self-review from a fresh context

highlights.zh: 持续学习：把反复奏效的做法固化成可复用的技能和工作流
highlights.en: Continuous learning turns repeated wins into reusable skills and workflows

intro.zh: Firecrawl 是给 AI 智能体用的网页数据 API：把任意网址转成干净的 markdown、结构化 JSON 或截图，也能搜索网页、整站爬取、批量抓取，还能在页面上点击、滚动、输入之后再提取内容。它可以自托管也是托管服务，接任意 MCP 客户端只要一条命令。
intro.en: Firecrawl is a web data API for AI agents: turn any URL into clean markdown, structured JSON or screenshots, and also search the web, crawl a whole site or batch-scrape thousands of URLs. It can click, scroll and type on a page before extracting, and connects to any agent or MCP client in one command.

cardLine.zh: 把网页变成智能体可用数据的 API：搜索、抓取、交互、整站爬取。
cardLine.en: A web data API that turns sites into agent-ready data: search, scrape, interact and crawl.

entries.name: OmniRoute
entries.description: Never stop coding. Free MIT AI gateway: one endpoint, 359 providers (150+ free), 1200+ models Kimi, Claude, GPT, Gemini, GLM, DeepSeek, MiniMax. Works with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, Cline & Copilot. Quota-aware auto-fallback, RTK+Caveman compression saves 15-95% tokens, MCP/A2A, Desktop/PWA. Built by hundreds of contributors

why.zh: 近 7 天新增 2,171 star（日均约 310，相对存量增速 3%），累计 72,783 star、10,423 fork。窗口内被 fork 388 次，近 30 天新建 PR 200 个、issue 200 个，100 位贡献者共同维护。
why.en: Gained 2,171 stars over the last 7 days (~310/day, 3% of its base), now at 72,783 stars and 10,423 forks. 388 new forks in the window; 200 PRs and 200 issues opened in the last 30 days; 100 contributors.

intro.zh: OmniRoute 是一个免费的 AI 网关：一个端点接上大量 provider 和模型（其中很多有免费额度），配额用尽时自动切到还有余额的渠道。它还会压缩上下文省 token，提供 MCP / A2A 接口和桌面端、PWA，可直接配合 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、Cline 等客户端使用。
intro.en: OmniRoute is a free AI gateway: one endpoint in front of hundreds of providers and 1200+ models, including many free tiers, with quota-aware fallback when one runs dry. It also compresses context to save tokens, speaks MCP/A2A, and ships as desktop and PWA for use with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Cline and friends.

cardLine.zh: 免费 AI 网关：一个端点接入多家模型，配额感知自动切换。
cardLine.en: A free AI gateway: one endpoint for hundreds of providers, with quota-aware auto-fallback.

highlights.zh: 配额感知自动回退：某个 provider 用尽或限流就换下一个
highlights.en: Quota-aware auto-fallback moves to the next provider when one is exhausted or rate-limited

entries.name: graphify
entries.description: Turn any codebase, with its docs, SQL schemas, configs, and PDFs, into a queryable knowledge graph. A /graphify skill for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and Gemini CLI: local deterministic AST parsing, every edge explained, no vector store.

why.zh: 近 7 天新增 1,905 star（日均约 272，相对存量增速 1.5%），累计 123,657 star、11,920 fork。窗口内被 fork 199 次，近 30 天新建 PR 200 个、issue 200 个，100 位贡献者共同维护。
why.en: Gained 1,905 stars over the last 7 days (~272/day, 1.5% of its base), now at 123,657 stars and 11,920 forks. 199 new forks in the window; 200 PRs and 200 issues opened in the last 30 days; 100 contributors.

intro.zh: Graphify 是一个 /graphify 技能：在 Claude Code、Cursor、Codex、Gemini CLI 里输入它，就能把整个项目（代码、文档、SQL schema、配置、PDF、图片）映射成一张可查询的知识图谱。代码用 tree-sitter 在本地确定性解析，然后你可以向图谱提问或查两个东西之间的路径，而不是靠 grep 翻文件。
intro.en: Graphify is a /graphify skill for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Gemini CLI and more: run it and your whole project — code, docs, SQL schemas, configs, PDFs, images — becomes a queryable knowledge graph. Code is parsed locally with deterministic tree-sitter ASTs, and afterwards you query the graph or trace paths instead of grepping through files.

cardLine.zh: 把代码库和文档变成可查询知识图谱的 /graphify 技能。
cardLine.en: A /graphify skill that turns a codebase and its docs into a queryable knowledge graph.

highlights.zh: 代码走 tree-sitter 本地 AST 解析，确定性、不调用 LLM、不出本机
highlights.en: Code is parsed with tree-sitter ASTs locally: deterministic, no LLM, nothing leaves your machine

highlights.zh: 每条边都标成 EXTRACTED 或 INFERRED，能分清哪些是直接读出来的
highlights.en: Every edge is tagged EXTRACTED or INFERRED, so you can tell what was read from what was derived

highlights.zh: graphify query 用自然语言返回子图，graphify path 追踪两点如何相连
highlights.en: graphify query returns a scoped subgraph for plain-language questions; graphify path traces how two things connect

highlights.zh: 不用向量库和 embedding，直接遍历真实图谱，兼容 15+ 编码助手
highlights.en: No embeddings or vector store — you traverse a real graph, in 15+ coding assistants

cons.zh: 未声明开源许可证，商用存在法务不确定性
cons.en: No open-source license declared — legal uncertainty for commercial use

cons.zh: 缺少官网与文档入口，上手成本较高
cons.en: No homepage or docs site — steeper onboarding

fitFor.zh: 要把 Agent 能力嵌进自己产品的开发者
fitFor.en: Developers embedding agent capabilities into their own product

fitFor.zh: 需要可扩展抽象层而非端到端方案的团队
fitFor.en: Teams wanting an extensible abstraction layer rather than a turnkey app

entries.name: hermes-agent
entries.description: The agent that grows with you

why.zh: 近 7 天新增 1,745 star（日均约 249，相对存量增速 0.7%），累计 251,080 star、53,864 fork。窗口内被 fork 881 次，近 30 天新建 PR 200 个、issue 200 个，100 位贡献者共同维护。
why.en: Gained 1,745 stars over the last 7 days (~249/day, 0.7% of its base), now at 251,080 stars and 53,864 forks. 881 new forks in the window; 200 PRs and 200 issues opened in the last 30 days; 100 contributors.

intro.zh: Hermes Agent 是 Nous Research 做的自我进化智能体：它会从完成的任务里自己总结出技能，在使用中继续改进，并跨会话记住关键信息和你的偏好。它能跑在 5 美元 VPS、GPU 集群，或在空闲时几乎不花钱的 serverless 上，从 Telegram、Discord、Slack 等渠道都能跟它对话。
intro.en: Hermes Agent is Nous Research's self-improving agent: it creates skills from experience, improves them during use, remembers what matters and searches its own past conversations. Run it on a $5 VPS, a GPU cluster or serverless infrastructure that costs nearly nothing when idle, and talk to it from Telegram, Discord, Slack, WhatsApp, Signal or the CLI.

cardLine.zh: 会自我进化的智能体：从经验生成技能、记住你，随处可跑。
cardLine.en: A self-improving agent that grows skills from experience, remembers you, and runs anywhere.

highlights.zh: 闭环学习：复杂任务完成后自动创建技能，并在使用中自我改进
highlights.en: A closed learning loop creates skills after complex tasks and improves them during use

highlights.zh: 跨会话记忆与历史对话检索，逐渐建立对用户的模型
highlights.en: Cross-session memory and conversation search build a deepening model of who you are

highlights.zh: 一个网关进程接入 Telegram、Discord、Slack、WhatsApp、Signal 和 CLI
highlights.en: A single gateway process connects Telegram, Discord, Slack, WhatsApp, Signal and the CLI

highlights.zh: 内置 cron 调度，可用自然语言安排日报、夜间备份、周度审计
highlights.en: A built-in cron scheduler runs daily reports, nightly backups and weekly audits in natural language

highlights.zh: 可派生子智能体并行工作，支持本地、Docker、SSH、Modal 等多种后端
highlights.en: Spawns isolated subagents for parallel work, across local, Docker, SSH, Modal and other backends

cons.zh: 开放 issue 47,916 个，相对 star 规模偏高
cons.en: 47,916 open issues — high relative to its star count

fitFor.zh: 关注 AI Agent 生态、想快速了解新项目的从业者
fitFor.en: Practitioners tracking the AI agent ecosystem
